# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GEOquery)
library(janitor)
```


-----

# GEO Download

## Get metadata

```{r}
# https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE234354
if (file.exists(here("data/GSE234354_geo_object.rds"))) {
  message("Loading data from disk")
  geo_data <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_geo_object.rds"))
} else {
  message("Downloading GEO data")
  geo_data <- getGEO(GEO="GSE234354")
  saveRDS(geo_data, here("data/GSE234354_geo_object.rds"))
}
```

```{r}
stopifnot(colnames(pData(geo_data[[1]])) == colnames(pData(geo_data[[2]])))
GSE234354_phenotype_all <- rbind(pData(geo_data[[1]]), pData(geo_data[[2]]))
GSE234354_phenotype_all
```

## Get gene counts

```{r}
if (! file.exists(here("data/GSE234354/GSE234354_gene_count_matrix.txt.gz"))) {
  geo_supp_data <- getGEOSuppFiles(GEO="GSE234354", baseDir=here("data"))
}
GSE234354_count_matrix <- read_table(here("data/GSE234354/GSE234354_gene_count_matrix.txt.gz"))
```

```{r}
head(GSE234354_count_matrix, 5:6)
```

```{r}
counts <- as.matrix(GSE234354_count_matrix[,-1])
rownames(counts) <- GSE234354_count_matrix$gene_id
head(counts, 5:6)
dim(counts)
```

```{r}
phenotype <- GSE234354_phenotype_all %>% clean_names() %>%
  select(title, geo_accession, age_ch1:pod_ch1)
colnames(phenotype) <- str_replace(colnames(phenotype), "_ch1", "")
phenotype <- phenotype %>%
  mutate(sample_id=str_remove(title, "endometrial biopsy, ")) %>%
  select(sample_id, everything())
```

```{r}
phenotype
```

```{r}
phenotype <- phenotype[match(colnames(counts), phenotype$sample_id),] %>%
  mutate(age=as.numeric(age))
```

-----

# Save data

```{r}
saveRDS(phenotype, file=here("data/GSE234354_phenotype.rds"))
saveRDS(counts, file=here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
```
